prompt:
You are a senior typographer and information designer. You lay out data tables for publication. You judge layouts by looking at the rendered result as a whole: what the table is for, how a reader scans and compares it, which columns belong together or play the same role, proportion and rhythm across columns, a clear hierarchy of headers and groups, whether rows read as units, whether words, numbers and identifiers stay intact, and how text and white space are distributed. Fewer lines or a shorter table is not automatically better, and neither is equal widths or symmetry; decide case by case and say why.

Table: API 错误码排查对照表 (language zh-CN).
Grid: 4 columns × 8 rows. Row headers: yes (first logical column identifies each row).
Per-column content facts (content px at 15px font, excluding padding):
  col 1: header "错误码" · longest unbreakable word 49px · one-line width 49px
  col 2: header "错误信息" · longest unbreakable word 154px · one-line width 154px
  col 3: header "含义" · longest unbreakable word 95px · one-line width 740px
  col 4: header "解决办法" · longest unbreakable word 110px · one-line width 1964px
Each column also has 21px of padding+border, so a column given width w px shows w−21 px of text.
Available width: 360px (the dashed pink box = the reader's viewport). The column widths you choose must sum to at most 359px.
This table cannot fit without splitting words at 360px. You MAY choose a total wider than 359px (the reader then scrolls horizontally), or squeeze and accept splits — a design decision.
Rendering convention: the screenshot always shows the WHOLE table. Anything beyond the dashed box is not clipped; it is the part a reader reaches by scrolling sideways, so judge both what fits in the box at first sight and the cost of scrolling to the rest.
Fixed: content, font, 15px font size, padding, borders, colours, alignment. You control ONLY the column widths.

The image shows the table's content with every cell on one line, so you can read everything. Study it first.
1) Understand it: what is the table for, how will people read, scan and compare it, which columns play the same or similar role, which values must stay intact, which text may wrap naturally, and where existing row height could absorb wrapping.
2) Propose 3 genuinely different column-width designs for 360px (different strategies, not small variations).
An earlier design attempt for this table was rejected by independent reviewers. Their comments: another layout was rated bad: All four columns fit initially, but the very narrow text columns split identifiers and turn the explanations and remedies into exceptionally tall, hard-to-scan rows. | another layout was rated acceptable: Error codes and message identifiers remain intact, and the meaning column is reasonably readable. The viewport cuts into that column, while the remedies require horizontal scrolling. | another layout was rated acceptable: The first three columns fit almost entirely in the viewport and identifiers remain intact. The very tall rows create substantial empty space beside the shorter cells, and remedies require scrolling. | your previous preferred design was rated poor: Codes and message identifiers are easy to scan, but the viewport cuts through the meaning text, requiring sideways scrolling even to read the explanation; the remedies lie farther right. | another layout was rated acceptable: The first three columns are visible together and rows are relatively compact, but access_token is split across lines and remedies require scrolling. | another layout was rated good: Codes, message identifiers and meanings fit together in the initial view, including the intact access_token. The taller rows leave some empty space, and reading remedies requires horizontal scrolling.
another layout was rated acceptable: 错误码和错误信息完整易扫读，但视口边缘切过含义列，解决办法需要横向滚动。 | another layout was rated bad: 四列虽都放进视口，错误信息中的标识符却被拆成多行，解决办法也挤成很窄的文字条，行高过大。 | another layout was rated good: 错误码和错误信息保持完整，含义列也基本完整地出现在首屏；解决办法需要横向滚动，部分行因此较高。 | another layout was rated poor: 前三列易于识别，但行内留白很大，解决办法在视口外，读者需要横向滚动才能查看主要排查步骤。 | your previous preferred design was rated acceptable: 标识符完整，含义列较宽、换行较自然，但视口边缘切入含义文字，查看完整内容和解决办法都需要滚动。 | another layout was rated acceptable: 错误码和错误信息完整，但含义中的 access_token 被拆开，解决办法也位于视口外。
